verdict.rationale: Asana's own marketing documents built-in AI Teammates and pre-built agents that work inside team workflows and handle coordination-heavy work. They come with identity, scoped permissions and audit trails, and the API exposes configured agents. However, no evidence shows how a user actually delegates or assigns a task to these agents, and all support is vendor claims. missing for 10: documented mechanism for assigning/delegating individual tasks to an AI Teammate, details of what actions agents perform on delegated tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Pre-built AI agents that work alongside your team inside real workflows, with shared memory, governance, and context from the Work Graph
Turn your team's collective expertise into custom AI Teammates built to handle the complex, coordination-heavy work that slows your team down.
Every agent has an identity, scoped permissions, an audit trail, and cost constraints
Returns the compact records of agents (AI Teammates) configured.
